first.rationale: Prioritize simplifying onboarding because onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and inherited evidence indicates onboarding and signup simplification improve early adoption. Verify memory_86 to confirm the broader onboarding effect and memory_73 because aggressive competitor pricing makes promotional pricing a consequential alternative, but it may attract lower-quality, less sustainable revenue. Run a standard experiment focused on completion, activation, qualified pipeline or revenue, and downstream retention/value rather than optimizing completion alone.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding, prioritizing the current 4% completion decline and 6% activation decline. The verified onboarding record shows improved completion, 2.1-day faster time-to-value, and 3% higher 30-day retention, supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Signup simplification provides additional relevant support. Do not pursue promotional pricing: although it increased qualified revenue initially, 30-day retention fell 12% and the cohort failed to survive the first renewal cycle. Measure completion and activation alongside time-to-value, qualified revenue, renewal or retention, and account quality to protect downstream value.
